answer: Rhythm-Slot Rate Ceiling. Each identity submits work only in a timing slot derived from its own key, and the scheduler accepts bursts only near that offset; traffic arriving off-slot is delayed to the next cycle like water crossing a mesa. Honest agents spread evenly, but a sybil cluster wanting instant throughput must buy or wait out slots across the full tundra of cycles. To sustain N fake identities at usable rate, an attacker pays continuous idle capacity and slot acquisition on every one, tracked to a zenith of wasted overhead that grows with cluster size.
